verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI-driven insights inside the product: audit agents flagging risk levels, review agents auto-approving/escalating, Brex AI drafting payments and matching POs, and policy compliance suggestions, plus an official MCP server for natural-language queries over expense/card/banking data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of these AI features' accuracy and no detailed docs on the underlying insight-generation mechanics beyond marketing copy.
